steps.title: Install the Premiere panel
steps.detail: Unify copies the DSH Bridge panel into Adobe's extensions folder and allows unsigned panels to load (Adobe's PlayerDebugMode, which applies to every unsigned panel).

steps.title: Install the Premiere panel
steps.detail: Unify copies the DSH Bridge panel into Adobe's extensions folder and allows unsigned panels to load (Adobe's PlayerDebugMode, which applies to every unsigned panel).

steps.title: Open the panel in Premiere
steps.detail: Restart Premiere Pro, then open Window > Extensions > DSH Bridge. Keep the panel open while agents work; it connects by itself.
